newsitem.title: GERMANY: Porsche tows rollerblader to record speed.
newsitem.headline: Porsche tows rollerblader to record speed.

text.p: An engineering student on rollerblades has claimed a world speed record after holding on to the back of a sports car as it reached 246 km per hour (153 mph) , a German newspaper reported on Sunday.

Bild am Sonntag said 25-year-old Dirk Auer, wearing a crash helmet, leather motorcycle kit and four-wheel in-line skates, clung to a specially built rack on the back of a 550 horse-power Porsche as it raced around the 2,000-metre Hockenheim track.
Wind and rain prevented Auer, from Gross-Gerau near Frankfurt, from reaching his hoped-for 300 kph (186 mph), the newspaper said.
